motivation: Posthoc baseline Dev diagnostic89/114 identity changes follow a missed-match gap; many co-occur with box overlap. This is not proof of occlusion causality.
target: For an IoU>=0.5 matched class1 fish, positive if its GT box intersection/minimum-area with any other class1 GT box is>=0.35. This is only a box-overlap risk proxy, not actual visibility or segmentation.
features: Frozen existing512D RGB reference plus own-box logwidth/logheight/logarea/aspect. Compare equal-capacity additional512D RGB or actual newIR native encoder features, seeds0/1/2. No new encoder training, images or feature caches.
classifier: Ordinary Train-only logistic regression, C0.01, lbfgs, max_iter2000,tol1e-6. Train-only weighted mean/std floor0.001; equal video and within-video present classes. All7 fits serialized before any Dev labels.
Dev: Complete2 videos x2 existing global proposal fronts, all eligible foreground proposals. AUC/AP only; no HOTA/deployment/Test claim.
activation: A future tracker change requires an IR advantage over strongest RGB/reference across both videos; otherwise retain negative diagnostic and do not deploy.
